name: [AWS] Find all GROUPS that contain 'AWS' or 'AMAZON' in their names
query: MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Group OR n:AZGroup) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*(aws|amazon).*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*(aws|amazon).*') RETURN n

name: [AWS] Find all USERS that are members of groups containing 'AWS' or 'AMAZON' in their names
query: MATCH p=(m)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(n) WHERE (m:User OR m:AZUser) AND (n:Group OR n:AZGroup) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*(aws|amazon).*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*(aws|amazon).*') RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] All Computers Local Admin to Another Computer
query: MATCH p=(c1:Computer)-[:MemberOf|HasSIDHistory|AdminTo*1..]->(c2:Computer) WHERE c1 <> c2 RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] All Computers in Domain Admins
query: MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[:MemberOf|HasSIDHistory*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Computers with administrative Domain Users
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:AddMember|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|AllowedToDelegate|CanRDP|Contains|ExecuteDCOM|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|GetChanges|GetChangesAll|HasSession|Owns|ReadLAPSPassword|SQLAdmin|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|AddAllowedToAct|AllowedToAct]->(t) WHERE m.objectsid ENDS WITH '-513' OR m.objectsid ENDS WITH '-515' OR m.objectsid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-11' OR m.objectsid ENDS WITH 'S-1-1-0' RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Find all active Domain Admin sessions
query: MATCH (n:User)-[:MemberOf]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' MATCH p = (c:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(n) return p

name: [Admin Hunter] Find all owned users that have local admin rights
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((m:User:Tag_Owned)-[r:HasSession|AdminTo|MemberOf*1..]->(n:Computer)) RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Find all users that have direct local admin rights
query: MATCH p=(m:User)-[r:AdminTo]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Find all users that have local admin rights or Groups (Warning Can Be Heavy)
query: MATCH p=(m:User)-[r:AdminTo|MemberOf*1..]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Find groups that have local admin rights (Warning: Heavy)
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:AdminTo]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Privileged Service Account Risk
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) WHERE u.hasspn = true AND u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (365 * 86400)) RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Shadow Admin Detection
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:GenericAll|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|ExecuteDCOM|GenericWrite|AllExtendedRights|ForceChangePassword]->(:Computer) WHERE NOT u:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN p

name: [Admin Hunter] Users with most local admin rights
query: MATCH (u:User)-[:MemberOf|AdminTo*1..]->(c:Computer) WITH u, count(c) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH p=(u)-[:MemberOf|AdminTo*1..]->(:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Azure] All Owned Principals
query: MATCH (o) WHERE o:Tag_Owned RETURN o

name: [Azure] Find All edges any owned user has on a device, vm, app, keyvault etc.
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((m:AZUser:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(b)) WHERE NOT m=b AND (b:AZDevice OR b:AZVM OR b:AZApp OR b:AZKeyVault OR b:AZFunctionApp OR b:AZTenant OR b:AZSubscription OR b:AZResourceGroup OR b:AZLogicApp) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find Azure users with MFA disabled who have privileged roles
query: MATCH p=(u:AZUser)-[:AZMemberOf|AZHasRole*1..]->(r:AZRole:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find all Owners of Azure Applications
query: MATCH p = (n)-[r:AZOwns]->(g:AZApp) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find all Owners of Azure VMs
query: MATCH p = (n)-[r:AZOwns]->(g:AZVM) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find all Privileged Service Principals
query: MATCH p = (g:AZServicePrincipal)-[r]->(n) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find all paths to an Azure KeyVault
query: MATCH p = (n)-[r]->(g:AZKeyVault) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find all shortest paths to an Azure KeyVault
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((n)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(g:AZKeyVault)) WHERE n <> g RETURN p

name: [Azure] Find all shortest paths to an Azure VM
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(g:AZVM)) WHERE NOT n=g RETURN p

name: [Azure] List All High Value Targets
query: MATCH (m:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN m

name: [Azure] List Azure Apps (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (n:AZApp) RETURN n LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Devices (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZDevice) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Groups (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZGroup) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Key Vaults (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZKeyVault) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Resource Groups (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZResourceGroup) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Service Principals (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZServicePrincipal) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Tenants (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZTenant) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure Users (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZUser) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure VMs (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH (m:AZVM) RETURN m LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] List Azure roles that can reset password
[Azure] List all owned devices
query: MATCH (m:AZDevice:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r:AZContains*1..]->(m) RETURN m, r, g

name: [Azure] List all owned groups
query: MATCH (m:AZGroup:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r:AZContains*1..]->(m) RETURN m, r, g

name: [Azure] List all owned users
query: MATCH (u:AZUser:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[r:AZMemberOf|AZHasRole*1..]->(g) WHERE (g:AZRole OR g:AZGroup) AND g:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN u, g, r

name: [Azure] List groups of all owned users
query: MATCH (m:AZUser:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[r:AZMemberOf*1..]->(n) RETURN m, r, n

name: [Azure] Return All Azure AD Groups that are synchronized with On-Premise AD
query: MATCH (n:AZGroup) WHERE n.objectid CONTAINS 'S-1-5' AND n.azsyncid IS NOT NULL RETURN n

name: [Azure] Return All Azure Admins and their owned Devices
query: MATCH p=(d:AZDevice)<-[r1:AZOwns]->(m:AZUser)<-[r2:AZHasRole]->(n) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Return All Azure Users and their Admin Roles
query: MATCH p=(n)-[:AZHasRole|AZMemberOf*1..]->(:AZRole) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Return All Azure Users and their Groups (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH p=(m:AZUser)-[r:AZMemberOf|MemberOf]->(n) WHERE NOT m.objectid CONTAINS 'S-1-5' RETURN p LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] Return All Azure Users and their Groups (Warning: Heavy)
query: MATCH p=(m:AZUser)-[r:AZMemberOf*1..]->(n) WHERE NOT m.objectid CONTAINS 'S-1-5' RETURN p

name: [Azure] Return All Azure Users and their owned Devices (Warning: Heavy)
query: MATCH p=(d:AZDevice)<-[r1:AZOwns]->(m:AZUser) RETURN p

name: [Azure] Return All Azure Users that are part of the 'Global Administrator' Role
query: MATCH p =(n)-[r:AZGlobalAdmin*1..]->(m) RETURN n, p

name: [Azure] Return All On-Prem users with edges to Azure
query: MATCH  p=(m:User)-[r:AZResetPassword|AZOwns|AZUserAccessAdministrator|AZContributor|AZAddMembers|AZGlobalAdmin|AZVMContributor|AZOwns|AZAvereContributor]->(n) WHERE m.objectid CONTAINS 'S-1-5-21' RETURN p

name: [Azure] Return All Owned Azure Users and their Groups (Limit: 50)
query: MATCH p=(m:AZUser:Tag_Owned)-[r:AZMemberOf|MemberOf]->(n) WHERE NOT m.objectid CONTAINS 'S-1-5' RETURN p LIMIT 50

name: [Azure] Return Azure Devices with the most edges (Limit: 25)
query: MATCH (m:AZDevice)-[r]-() WITH m, count(r) AS num ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 25 RETURN m

name: [Azure] Return Azure Users with the most edges (Limit: 25)
query: MATCH (m:AZUser)-[r]-() WITH m, count(r) AS num ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 25 RETURN m

name: [Azure] Return GUEST Azure Users and their Groups
query: MATCH p=(m:AZUser)-[r:AZMemberOf*1..]->(n) WHERE NOT m.objectid CONTAINS 'S-1-5' AND m.userprincipalname=~ '(?i).*#EXT#.*' RETURN p

name: [Azure] Return all owned azure objects
query: MATCH (m:AZBase:Tag_Owned) RETURN m

name: [Certificate Queries] Find Certificate Authorities
query: MATCH (n:EnterpriseCA) RETURN n

name: [Certificate Queries] Find Certificate Authorities with HTTP Web Enrollment (ESC8)
query: MATCH (n:EnterpriseCA) WHERE n.adcswebenrollmenthttp = true RETURN n

name: [Certificate Queries] Find Certificate Authorities with User Specified SAN (ESC6)
query: MATCH (n:EnterpriseCA) WHERE n.isuserspecifiessanenabled = true RETURN n

name: [Certificate Queries] Find Enrollment Agent Templates (ESC3)
query: MATCH p=(n:CertTemplate)-[:PublishedTo]->(:EnterpriseCA) WHERE (size(n.effectiveekus) = 0 OR '2.5.29.37.0' IN n.effectiveekus OR '1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.1' IN n.effectiveekus) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Find Misconfigured Certificate Templates (ESC1)
query: MATCH p=(n:CertTemplate)-[:PublishedTo]->(:EnterpriseCA) WHERE n.enrolleesuppliessubject = true AND n.authenticationenabled = true RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Find Misconfigured Certificate Templates (ESC2)
query: MATCH p=(n:CertTemplate)-[:PublishedTo]->(:EnterpriseCA) WHERE (size(n.effectiveekus) = 0 OR '2.5.29.37.0' IN n.effectiveekus) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Find all Certificate Templates
query: MATCH (n:CertTemplate) RETURN n

name: [Certificate Queries] Find enabled Certificate Templates
query: MATCH p=(n:CertTemplate)-[:PublishedTo]->(:EnterpriseCA) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Enrollment Agent Templates from Owned Principals (ESC3)
query: MATCH p=(g:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf*0..]->()-[:ADCSESC3]->(d:Domain) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Misconfigured Certificate Templates from Owned Principals (ESC1)
query: MATCH p=(g:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf*0..]->()-[:ADCSESC1]->(d:Domain) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Misconfigured Certificate Templates from Owned Principals (ESC2)
query: MATCH p=(g:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf*0..]->()-[:Enroll|GenericAll|AllExtendedRights]->(n:CertTemplate) WHERE (size(n.effectiveekus) = 0 OR '2.5.29.37.0' IN n.effectiveekus) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Vulnerable Certificate Authority Access Control (ESC7)
query: MATCH p=(g)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|ManageCA|ManageCertificates]->(n:EnterpriseCA) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Vulnerable Certificate Authority Access Control from Owned Principals (ESC7)
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((g:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(n:EnterpriseCA)) WHERE g <> n RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Vulnerable Certificate Template Access Control (ESC4)
query: MATCH p=(g)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner]->(n:CertTemplate) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Shortest Paths to Vulnerable Certificate Template Access Control from Owned Principals (ESC4)
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((g:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(n:CertTemplate)) WHERE g <> n RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Show Enrollment Rights for Certificate Template
query: MATCH p=()-[:Enroll|GenericAll|AllExtendedRights]->(n:CertTemplate) RETURN p

name: [Certificate Queries] Show Rights for Certificate Authority
query: MATCH p=()-[:ManageCA|ManageCertificates|Enroll]->(n:EnterpriseCA) RETURN p

name: [Cross-Domain Information] All Users with with Same Name in Different Domains
query: MATCH (u1:User),(u2:User) WHERE split(u1.name,'@')[0] = split(u2.name,'@')[0] AND u1.domain <> u2.domain AND toint(split(u1.objectid,'-')[7]) >= 1000 RETURN u1

name: [Cross-Domain Information] Find OWNED principals that can do something to a foreign object (exclude domain admins)
query: MATCH (da)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-512' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-519' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-516' OR g.objectid =~ '.*-S-1-5-32-544'  WITH COLLECT(da) AS exclude MATCH p=allShortestPaths((n:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf|HasSession|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|AddMember|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|CanRDP|ExecuteDCOM|AllowedToDelegate|ReadLAPSPassword|Contains|GPLink|AddAllowedToAct|AllowedToAct|WriteAccountRestrictions|SQLAdmin|ReadGMSAPassword|HasSIDHistory|CanPSRemote|SyncLAPSPassword|DumpSMSAPassword|AZMGGrantRole|AZMGAddSecret|AZMGAddOwner|AZMGAddMember|AZMGGrantAppRoles|AZNodeResourceGroup|AZWebsiteContributor|AZAutomationContributor|AZAKSContributor|AZAddMembers|AZAddOwner|AZAddSecret|AZAvereContributor|AZContains|AZContributor|AZExecuteCommand|AZGetCertificates|AZGetKeys|AZGetSecrets|AZGlobalAdmin|AZHasRole|AZManagedIdentity|AZMemberOf|AZOwns|AZPrivilegedAuthAdmin|AZPrivilegedRoleAdmin|AZResetPassword|AZUserAccessAdministrator|AZAppAdmin|AZCloudAppAdmin|AZRunsAs|AZKeyVaultContributor|AZVMAdminLogin|AZVMContributor|AZLogicAppContributor|AddSelf|WriteSPN|AddKeyCredentialLink|DCSync*1..]->(m)) WHERE (n:User OR n:Computer) AND (m:User OR m:Computer OR m:GPO) AND NOT n IN exclude AND NOT n.domain = m.domain RETURN p

name: [Cross-Domain Information] Find an object in one domain that can do something to a foreign object
query: MATCH p=(n)-[r]->(m) WHERE NOT n.domain = m.domain RETURN p

name: [Cross-Domain Information] Find principals that can do something to a foreign object (exclude domain admins)
query: MATCH (da)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-512' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-519' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-516' OR g.objectid =~ '.*-S-1-5-32-544'  WITH COLLECT(da) AS exclude MATCH p=allShortestPaths((n)-[:MemberOf|HasSession|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|AddMember|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|CanRDP|ExecuteDCOM|AllowedToDelegate|ReadLAPSPassword|Contains|GPLink|AddAllowedToAct|AllowedToAct|WriteAccountRestrictions|SQLAdmin|ReadGMSAPassword|HasSIDHistory|CanPSRemote|SyncLAPSPassword|DumpSMSAPassword|AZMGGrantRole|AZMGAddSecret|AZMGAddOwner|AZMGAddMember|AZMGGrantAppRoles|AZNodeResourceGroup|AZWebsiteContributor|AZAutomationContributor|AZAKSContributor|AZAddMembers|AZAddOwner|AZAddSecret|AZAvereContributor|AZContains|AZContributor|AZExecuteCommand|AZGetCertificates|AZGetKeys|AZGetSecrets|AZGlobalAdmin|AZHasRole|AZManagedIdentity|AZMemberOf|AZOwns|AZPrivilegedAuthAdmin|AZPrivilegedRoleAdmin|AZResetPassword|AZUserAccessAdministrator|AZAppAdmin|AZCloudAppAdmin|AZRunsAs|AZKeyVaultContributor|AZVMAdminLogin|AZVMContributor|AZLogicAppContributor|AddSelf|WriteSPN|AddKeyCredentialLink|DCSync*1..]->(m)) WHERE (n:User OR n:Computer) AND (m:User OR m:Computer OR m:GPO) AND NOT n IN exclude AND NOT n.domain = m.domain RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] ACL Abuse Opportunities
query: MATCH p=(n)-[:WriteDacl|WriteOwner|GenericAll]->(t:Tag_Tier_Zero) WHERE NOT n:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] All ACLs to Computers (excluding High Value Targets)
query: MATCH p = (ucg)-[r]->(c:Computer) WHERE (ucg:User OR ucg:Computer OR ucg:Group) AND NOT ucg:Tag_Tier_Zero AND r.isacl = true RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Find Users/Groups with direct access to GPOs
query: MATCH p = (n)-[r:AddMember|AddSelf|WriteSPN|AddKeyCredentialLink|AllExtendedRights|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns]->(g:GPO) RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Find all other Rights Domain Users shouldn't have
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:Owns|WriteDacl|GenericAll|WriteOwner|ExecuteDCOM|GenericWrite|AllowedToDelegate|ForceChangePassword]->(n:Computer) WHERE m.objectid ENDS WITH '-513' OR m.objectsid ENDS WITH '-515' OR m.objectsid ENDS WITH 'S-1-5-11' OR m.objectsid ENDS WITH 'S-1-1-0' RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Find groups that can reset passwords
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:ForceChangePassword]->(n:User) RETURN m

name: [Dangerous Rights] Find groups that can reset passwords (Warning: Heavy)
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:ForceChangePassword]->(n:User) RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Find if any domain user has interesting permissions against a GPO (Warning: Heavy)
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[r:AllExtendedRights|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|GPLink*1..]->(g:GPO) RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Find if unprivileged users have rights to add members into groups
query: MATCH (n:User {admincount:False}) MATCH p=allShortestPaths((n)-[r:AddMember*1..]->(m:Group)) RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Non Admin Groups with High Value Privileges
query: MATCH p=(g:Group)-[r:Owns|WriteDacl|GenericAll|WriteOwner|ExecuteDCOM|GenericWrite|AllowedToDelegate|ForceChangePassword]->(n:Computer)  WHERE NOT g.name CONTAINS 'ADMIN' RETURN p

name: [Dangerous Rights] Owned users with permissions against GPOs
query: MATCH p=(u:User:Tag_Owned)-[r:AllExtendedRights|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|GPLink*1..]->(g:GPO) RETURN p

name: [Delegation] All Constrained Delegations
query: MATCH p = (a)-[:AllowedToDelegate]->(c:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Delegation] All RBCD
query: MATCH p = (a)-[:AllowedToAct]->(c:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Delegation] All Unconstrained Delegation Principals (excluding Domain Controllers and Administrators)
query: MATCH (dca)-[r:MemberOf*0..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-516' OR g.objectid =~ '.*-S-1-5-32-544' WITH COLLECT(dca) AS exclude MATCH p = (d:Domain)-[r:Contains*1..]->(uc) WHERE (uc:User OR uc:Computer) AND uc.unconstraineddelegation = true AND NOT uc IN exclude RETURN p

name: [Delegation] Find all computers with Unconstrained Delegation
query: MATCH (c:Computer {unconstraineddelegation:true}) return c

name: [Delegation] Find computers that allow unconstrained delegation that AREN'T domain controllers.
query: MATCH (c1:Computer)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-516' WITH COLLECT(c1.name) AS domainControllers MATCH (c2:Computer {unconstraineddelegation:true}) WHERE NOT c2.name IN domainControllers RETURN c2

name: [Delegation] Find computers with constrained delegation permissions and the corresponding targets where they allowed to delegate
query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.allowedtodelegate IS NOT NULL RETURN c

name: [Delegation] Find constrained delegation
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:AllowedToDelegate]->(c:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Delegation] Find exploitable paths to RBCD (exclude domain admins)
query: MATCH (admins)-[r:MemberOf*0..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-512' OR g.objectid =~ 's-1-5-.*-519' WITH COLLECT(admins) as exclude MATCH p = (u:User)-[r:MemberOf*0..]->(g:Group)-[r1:GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|AddAllowedToAct|WriteAccountRestrictions]->(c:Computer) WHERE NOT u IN exclude RETURN p

name: [Delegation] Shortest paths from owned principals to unconstrained delegation systems
query: MATCH (n:Tag_Owned) MATCH p=shortestPath((n)-[:MemberOf|HasSession|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|AddMember|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|ExecuteDCOM|AllowedToDelegate|ReadLAPSPassword|Contains|GPLink|AddAllowedToAct|AllowedToAct|SQLAdmin|ReadGMSAPassword|HasSIDHistory|CanPSRemote*1..]->(m:Computer {unconstraineddelegation: true})) WHERE NOT n=m RETURN p

name: [Group Hunts] All Domain Groups with Members
query: MATCH (g:Group) RETURN g

name: [Group Hunts] Find groups that contain both users and computers
query: MATCH (c:Computer)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WITH DISTINCT g MATCH (u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g) RETURN DISTINCT g

name: [Group Hunts] Nested Group Analysis
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:MemberOf*3..]->(g:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN p

name: [High Value/Owned] All Owned Nodes
query: MATCH (n:Tag_Owned) RETURN n

name: [High Value/Owned] Find All edges any owned user has on a computer
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((m:User:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(b:Computer)) WHERE NOT m=b RETURN p

name: [High Value/Owned] Find computers with owned Admins
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((n:User:Tag_Owned)-[r:AdminTo|MemberOf*1..]->(c:Computer)) return p

name: [High Value/Owned] Find owned Domain Admins
query: MATCH (n:Group) WHERE n.name =~ '(?i).*DOMAIN ADMINS.*' AND n:Tag_Owned WITH n MATCH p=(n)<-[r:MemberOf*1..]-(m) RETURN p

name: [High Value/Owned] Groups of High Value Targets
query: MATCH p=(n:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(m:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN p

name: [High Value/Owned] List all High Valued Targets
query: MATCH (m) WHERE m:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN m LIMIT 100

name: [High Value/Owned] List all owned computers
query: MATCH (m:Computer:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r:Contains*1..]->(m) RETURN m, r, g

name: [High Value/Owned] List all owned groups
query: MATCH (m:Group:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r:Contains*1..]->(m) RETURN m, r, g

name: [High Value/Owned] List all owned users
query: MATCH (u:User:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN u, g, r

name: [High Value/Owned] List groups of all owned users
query: MATCH (m:User:Tag_Owned) OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(n) RETURN m, r, n

name: [High Value/Owned] Show all high value target's groups
query: MATCH p=(n:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(m) WHERE (m:Group OR m:AZGroup) AND m:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN p

name: [High Value/Owned] View all GPOs
query: Match (n:GPO) RETURN n

name: [Kerberos] All Kerberoastable Users
query: MATCH (n {hasspn: true}) RETURN n

name: [Kerberos] Find All Users with an SPN/Find all Kerberoastable Users with passwords last set less than 5 years ago
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.hasspn = true AND u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (1825 * 86400)) AND NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

name: [Kerberos] Find Kerberoastable Users with a path to DA
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((u:User)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(g:Group)) WHERE u.hasspn = true AND g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' RETURN p

name: [Kerberos] Find Kerberoastable users and where they are AdminTo
query: OPTIONAL MATCH (u1:User) WHERE u1.hasspn=true OPTIONAL MATCH (u1)-[r:AdminTo]->(c:Computer) RETURN u1

name: [Kerberos] Find Kerberoastable users who are members of high value groups
query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g:Tag_Tier_Zero AND u.hasspn=true RETURN u

name: [Kerberos] Find all Kerberoastable Users
query: MATCH (n:User)WHERE n.hasspn=true RETURN n

name: [Kerberos] Find users that can be AS-REP roasted
query: MATCH (u:User {dontreqpreauth: true}) RETURN u

name: [Kerberos] Kerberoastable Admins
query: MATCH (n:Group) WHERE n.objectsid =~ '(?i)S-1-5-.*-512' WITH n MATCH p=(n)<-[:MemberOf*1..]-(m {hasspn: true}) RETURN p

name: [Keywords] Return the name of every computer in the database where at least one SPN for the computer contains the string 'JENKINS'
query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE ANY (x IN c.serviceprincipalnames WHERE x =~ '(?i).*jenkins.*') RETURN c

name: [Keywords] Return the name of every computer in the database where at least one SPN for the computer contains the string 'JIRA'
query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE ANY (x IN c.serviceprincipalnames WHERE x =~ '(?i).*jira.*') RETURN c

name: [Keywords] Return the name of every computer in the database where at least one SPN for the computer contains the string 'MSSQL'
query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE ANY (x IN c.serviceprincipalnames WHERE x =~ '(?i).*MSSQL.*') RETURN c

name: [Keywords] All Principals with '<password-like string>' in AD Description
query: MATCH (u) WHERE u.description =~ '(?=.*?[A-Za-z])(?=.*?[0-9])(?=.*?[^\\w\\s]).{6,}' RETURN u

name: [Keywords] All Principals with 'BACKUP' in AD Description
query: MATCH (u) WHERE u.description =~ '(?i).*backup.*' RETURN u

name: [Keywords] All Principals with 'LOGIN' in AD Description
query: MATCH (u) WHERE u.description =~ '(?i).*login.*' RETURN u

name: [Keywords] All Principals with 'PASS' in AD Description
query: MATCH (u) WHERE u.description =~ '(?i).*pass.*' RETURN u

name: [Keywords] All enabled computers with a description containing the word file
query: MATCH p = (d:Domain)-[r:Contains*1..]->(c:Computer) WHERE c.description =~ '(?i).*file.*' RETURN p

name: [Keywords] Find users with 'Temp' in user title and created in the last 30 days
query: MATCH (u:User) where u.enabled=TRUE and u.whencreated  > (datetime().epochseconds - (30 * 86400)) AND u.title CONTAINS 'Temp' RETURN u

name: [Keywords] Find users with 'password' in AD description fields
query: MATCH (m:User) WHERE toLower(m.description) CONTAINS 'password' RETURN m

name: [Keywords] Locate enabled accounts with display name of 'admin'
query: MATCH p=(d:Domain)-[:Contains*1..]->(u:User) WHERE u.displayname =~ '(?i).*admin.*' AND u.enabled = true RETURN p

name: [Keywords] View all groups that contain the word 'ADM'
query: Match (n) WHERE (n:Group OR n:AZGroup) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*adm.*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*adm.*')  RETURN n

name: [Keywords] View all groups that contain the word 'admin'
query: Match (n:Group) WHERE n.name CONTAINS 'ADMIN' RETURN n

name: [Keywords] View all users or groups that contain 'JENKINS' in their names
query: MATCH (m) WHERE  (m:User OR m:Group OR m:AZUser OR m:AZGroup) AND  (m.name =~ '(?i).*jenkins.*' OR m.azname =~ '(?i).*jenkins.*') RETURN m

name: [Keywords] View all users that contain the word 'ADM'
query: Match (n) WHERE (n:User OR n:AZUser) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*adm.*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*adm.*')  RETURN n

name: [Keywords] View all users that contain the words 'SERVICE' or 'SVC'
query: Match (n) WHERE (n:User OR n:AZUser) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*(service|svc).*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*(service|svc).*')  RETURN n

name: [LAPS] All Computers with LAPS
query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.haslaps = true RETURN c

name: [LAPS] All Computers without LAPS
query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.haslaps = false RETURN c

name: [LAPS] All Computers without LAPS - with session
query: MATCH p = (d:Domain)-[r:Contains*1..]->(c:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(y) WHERE c.haslaps = false RETURN p

name: [LAPS] All Principals that can sync LAPS passwords (excluding Domain Admins)
query: MATCH (adm)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-512' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-519' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-516' WITH COLLECT(adm) AS exclude MATCH p = (u)-[r:SyncLAPSPassword|MemberOf*1..]->(c) WHERE NOT u IN exclude RETURN p

name: [LAPS] All Users that can read LAPS passwords (excluding Domain Admins)
query: MATCH (adm)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-512' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-519' OR g.objectid =~ 'S-1-5-.*-516' WITH COLLECT(adm) AS exclude MATCH p = (u:User)-[r:ReadLAPSPassword|MemberOf*1..]->(c:Computer) WHERE NOT u IN exclude RETURN p

name: [LAPS] All computers without LAPS and the computer is enabled
query: MATCH p = (d:Domain)-[r:Contains*1..]->(c:Computer) WHERE c.haslaps = false AND c.enabled = true RETURN p

name: [LAPS] LAPS Deployment Gap Analysis
query: MATCH p=(ou:OU)-[:Contains]->(c:Computer) WHERE c.enabled = true AND c.haslaps = false RETURN p

name: [OS Finder] Find Server 2000 with session

name: [OS Finder] Find Server 2003 with session

name: [OS Finder] Find Server 2022 with session

name: [OS Finder] Find Un-Supported OS and Enabled
query: MATCH (n:Computer) WHERE n.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(2000|2003|2008|xp|vista|7|me).*' AND n.enabled = true RETURN n

name: [OS Finder] Find Windows 7 and Enabled
query: MATCH (H:Computer) WHERE H.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(7).*' AND H.enabled = true RETURN H

name: [OS Finder] Find Windows 7 session
query: MATCH (H:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(y) WHERE H.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(7).*' RETURN H

name: [OS Finder] Find Windows XP and Enabled
query: MATCH (H:Computer) WHERE H.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(xp).*' AND H.enabled = true RETURN H

name: [OS Finder] Find Windows XP with session
query: MATCH (H:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(y) WHERE H.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(xp).*' RETURN H

name: [OS Finder] Find all computers with unsupported operating systems
query: MATCH (H:Computer) WHERE H.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(2000|2003|2008|xp|vista|7|me).*' RETURN H

name: [OS Finder] Find all computers with unsupported operating systems - and enabled
query: MATCH (H:Computer) WHERE H.operatingsystem =~ '(?i).*(2000|2003|2008|xp|vista|7|me).*' AND H.enabled = true RETURN H

name: [PSRemote] Find all computers we can PSRemote into from owned constrained delegation
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:CanPSRemote|MemberOf*1..]->(c:Computer)<-[:AllowedToDelegate]-(m:Tag_Owned) RETURN p

name: [PSRemote] Find machines Domain Users can PSRemote into
query: MATCH p = shortestPath((u:User)-[r:CanPSRemote|MemberOf*1..]->(g:Computer)) WHERE NOT u = g RETURN p

name: [PSRemote] Find machines OWNED Principals can PSRemote into
query: MATCH p=(m:Tag_Owned)-[r:CanPSRemote]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [PSRemote] Find what GROUPS can PSRemote
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:CanPSRemote]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Password Hunts] All Users with Password not Required
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.passwordnotreqd = true RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Find all users with passwords set over 1440 days ago (47 months)
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.enabled=true AND u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (1440 * 86400)) and NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Find all users with passwords set over 720 days ago (23 months)
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.enabled=true AND u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (720 * 86400)) and NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Find users created in the last 30 days
query: MATCH (u:User) where u.enabled=TRUE and u.whencreated  > (datetime().epochseconds - (30 * 86400)) RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Find users that have never logged on and account is still active
query: MATCH (n:User) WHERE n.lastlogontimestamp=-1.0 AND n.enabled=TRUE RETURN n

name: [Password Hunts] Find users that haven't logged on in 720 days and account is still active
query: MATCH (n:User) WHERE n.lastlogontimestamp < (datetime().epochseconds - (720 * 86400)) AND n.enabled=TRUE RETURN n

name: [Password Hunts] Find users that logged in within the last 90 days
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.lastlogon < (datetime().epochseconds - (90 * 86400)) and NOT u.lastlogon IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Find users with blank passwords that are enabled
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.userpassword IS NOT NULL AND u.enabled = true RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Find users with passwords last set within the last 90 days
query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.pwdlastset < (datetime().epochseconds - (90 * 86400)) and NOT u.pwdlastset IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN u

name: [Password Hunts] Return users with a variant of "password" in their password and a path to high value targets (limit to 25 results)
query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "(.*[pP][aA@][sS$][sS$][wW][oO0][rR][dD].*)"  MATCH p=shortestPath((u1:User)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(n:Tag_Tier_Zero)) WHERE  u1<>n return u1 LIMIT 25

name: [Password Hunts] Return users with a variant of "password" in their password and are high value targets
query: MATCH (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "(.*[pP][aA@][sS$][sS$][wW][oO0][rR][dD].*)" MATCH p=(u1:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(m:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN u1

name: [Password Hunts] Return users with a variant of "password" in their password and have local admin on at least one computer
query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "(.*[pP][aA@][sS$][sS$][wW][oO0][rR][dD].*)" match p=(u1:User)-[r:AdminTo]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Password Hunts] Return users with seasons in their password and a path to high value targets (limit to 25 results)
query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "([Ww]inter.*|[sS]pring.*|[sS]ummer.*|[fF]all.*)" MATCH p=shortestPath((u1:User)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(n:Tag_Tier_Zero)) WHERE  u1<>n return u1 LIMIT 25

name: [Password Hunts] Return users with seasons in their password and are high value targets
query: MATCH (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "([Ww]inter.*|[sS]pring.*|[sS]ummer.*|[fF]all.*)" MATCH p=(u1:User)-[r:MemberOf*1..]->(m:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) RETURN u1

name: [Password Hunts] Return users with seasons in their password and have local admin on at least one computer
query: match (u1:User) WHERE u1.plaintextpassword =~ "([Ww]inter.*|[sS]pring.*|[sS]ummer.*|[fF]all.*)" match p=(u1:User)-[r:AdminTo]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [RDP] Find all computers we can RDP into from owned constrained delegation
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:CanRDP|MemberOf*1..]->(c:Computer)<-[:AllowedToDelegate]-(m:Tag_Owned) RETURN p

name: [RDP] Find machines Domain Users can RDP into
query: match p=(g:Group)-[:CanRDP]->(c:Computer) where g.objectid ENDS WITH '-513' return p

name: [RDP] Find machines OWNED Users can RDP into
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:CanRDP]->(n:Computer) WHERE m:Tag_Owned RETURN p

name: [RDP] Find what GROUPS can RDP
query: MATCH p=(m:Group)-[r:CanRDP]->(n:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from Kerberoastable Users to Computers
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((u:User)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(c:Computer)) WHERE u.hasspn = true RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from Kerberoastable Users to High Value Targets
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((u:User)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(h)) WHERE u.hasspn = true AND h:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from Owned Principals (including everything)
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((u:Tag_Owned)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(a)) WHERE NOT u=a AND (a:Domain OR a:AZTenant OR a:Tag_Tier_Zero)RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from Owned Principals to Domain
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((o:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(d:Domain)) WHERE o <> d RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from Owned Principals to High Value Targets
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((o)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(h)) WHERE o <> h AND o:Tag_Owned AND h:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from Owned Principals to no LAPS
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((o)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(c:Computer)) WHERE NOT o = c AND o:Tag_Owned AND c.haslaps = false RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from no Signing to Domain
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((c:Computer)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(d:Domain)) WHERE c.hassigning = false RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths from no Signing to High Value Targets
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((c:Computer)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(h)) WHERE NOT c = h AND c.hassigning = false AND h:Tag_Tier_Zero RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths to Azure Tenant
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((uc)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(d:AZTenant)) WHERE uc <> d RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths to Domain (including Computers)
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((uc)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(d:Domain)) WHERE (uc:User OR uc:Computer) RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] All Shortest Paths to no LAPS
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((uc)-[r:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(c:Computer)) WHERE (uc:User OR uc:Computer) AND NOT uc = c AND c.haslaps = false RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Cross-Domain Attack Paths
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((s:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf|HasSession|AdminTo|DCSync|AllExtendedRights|Contains|GPLink|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner*1..10]->(t:Tag_Tier_Zero)) WHERE s.domain <> t.domain RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Find Shortest Path from owned Node to Domain Admin
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((n:User:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf|AdminTo|HasSession|Contains|GPLink|Owns|DCSync|AllExtendedRights|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner*1..]->(m:Group)) WHERE m.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Find the Shortest path to a high value target from an owned object
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((g:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(n:Tag_Tier_Zero)) WHERE  g<>n return p

name: [Shortest Paths] Find the Shortest path to a unconstrained delegation system from an owned object
query: MATCH (n) MATCH p=shortestPath((n)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..]->(m:Computer {unconstraineddelegation: true})) WHERE NOT n=m AND n:Tag_Owned RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Most exploitable paths from owned objects to High Value Targets (5 hops)
query: MATCH p=allShortestPaths((n:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|AddMember|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|ExecuteDCOM|AllowedToDelegate|ReadLAPSPassword|Contains|GPLink|AddAllowedToAct|AllowedToAct|SQLAdmin|ReadGMSAPassword|HasSIDHistory*1..5]->(m:Tag_Tier_Zero)) WHERE NOT n=m RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Next steps (3 hops) from owned objects
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((c:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..3]->(s)) WHERE NOT c = s RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Next steps (5 hops) from owned objects
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((c:Tag_Owned)-[:ALL_ATTACK_PATHS*1..5]->(s)) WHERE NOT c = s RETURN p

name: [Shortest Paths] Shortest paths from owned objects to High Value Targets (5 hops)
query: MATCH p=shortestPath((n:Tag_Owned)-[:MemberOf|HasSession|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|AddMember|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|CanRDP|ExecuteDCOM|AllowedToDelegate|ReadLAPSPassword|Contains|GPLink|AddAllowedToAct|AllowedToAct|SQLAdmin|ReadGMSAPassword|HasSIDHistory|CanPSRemote*1..5]->(m:Tag_Tier_Zero)) WHERE NOT n=m RETURN p

name: [User Information] All Domain Computers
query: MATCH (c:Computer) RETURN c

name: [User Information] All Domain Users
query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u

name: [User Information] All Users with a homedirectory
query: MATCH p = (d:Domain)-[r:Contains*1..]->(u:User) WHERE u.homedirectory =~ '(?i).*.*' RETURN p

name: [User Information] All enabled computers with a description
query: MATCH p = (d:Domain)-[r:Contains*1..]->(c:Computer) WHERE c.description =~ '(?i).*.*' RETURN p

name: [User Information] Find all sessions a user in a specific domain has
query: MATCH p=(m:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(n:User) RETURN p

name: [User Information] Stale Accounts
query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group:Tag_Tier_Zero) WHERE u.enabled = true AND u.lastlogon < (datetime().epochseconds - (90 * 86400)) AND NOT u.lastlogon IN [-1.0, 0.0] RETURN p

name: [VPN] Find all GROUPS that are members of groups containing 'VPN' in their names
query: MATCH p=(m)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(n) WHERE (m:Group OR m:AZGroup) AND (n:Group OR n:AZGroup) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*vpn.*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*vpn.*') RETURN p

name: [VPN] Find all GROUPS that contain 'VPN' in their names
query: MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Group OR n:AZGroup) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*vpn.*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*vpn.*') RETURN n

name: [VPN] Find all USERS that are members of groups containing 'VPN' in their names
query: MATCH p=(m)-[:MemberOf]->(n) WHERE (m:User OR m:AZUser) AND (n:Group OR n:AZGroup) AND (n.name =~ '(?i).*vpn.*' OR n.azname =~ '(?i).*vpn.*') RETURN p

name: [VPN] Find all users a part of the VPN group
query: Match p=(u:User)-[:MemberOf]->(g:Group) WHERE toUPPER (g.name) CONTAINS 'VPN' return p
